summary.summary: PARTIAL: (b) exact for every amplitude, moving included (linear static law, record ledger E/(1 + k E g_yy), kept-ledger energy); the star's wall-independence in closed form and its failure for larger symmetric amplitudes; (a) the unmatched pull; (c) a two-place discriminator; (d) in ATTEMPT.md.

review: All 10 exact checks pass in about 50 s: with the simplest bond energy and held walls the ledger is a quadratic form in phi for every amplitude, so the static law is linear; a record's ledger is E/(1 + k E g_yy) exactly (boxes 7, 9); formation keeps the ledger iff E' = Lam/(1 - k Lam g_yy) (block 58 T1 for rest bodies; here also for a moving amplitude with hopping energy -0.458), with weak-field ratio to k(E^2 g_yy - e.g.e) of 1.0000099 at gamma = 1e-4; E' takes 4 values over a 3^3 cube's formation sites in box 7 (site-dependent), site-blind on Z^3; the star closed form c/(1 - k c) reproduces a3's 1188/1091 independently and is proved, while a 19-site ball and a distance-2 cross break wall-independence exactly (a3's locality is star-only); records-only momentum imbalance is the packet's pull (-0.013010); a two-place source gives the exact mean kick -0.063796 only under amplitude sourcing, versus 0, -0.161235, +0.033643 under records only. This matches the task's (b) and (c); (a) and (d) are argued in ATTEMPT.md; same model family as a3 and blocks 53-58, so a referee from another family is needed.
what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 4 of 4: Who sources the rate field: the amplitude, or only records? What each choice does to the ledger. SETTING (blocks 53, 54, 55; open PRs titled 'ail53: no master clock', 'ail54: a phase timed by the local clock', 'ail55: action and reaction'; all three rest on SUPPLIED clauses, not adopted; the axioms memo docs/MINIMAL_AXIOMS_2026-06-29.md defines no time metric, no amplitude dynamics and no conserved energy). BLOCK 53: every site of Z^3 has a positive tick rate w_x = phi_x^2 = exp(u_x), set by its six neighbours' rates through one covariant rule, and only ratios of rates mean anything; every such rule has the weak-field form u_x = average of u over the six neighbours; a record enters as a ratio kappa to its neighbours' mean (additive source log kappa). BLOCK 54: one moving record is a two-component amplitude whose phase is timed by the local clock, generator H_w = phi H phi, H the walk with the qubit as coin; in a uniform gradient force = -(energy) x grad u exactly; rays fall at -w^2 grad u + 2 (v.grad u) v at long wavelength; one walker has no rest energy. BLOCK 55 (premise: the field obeys a static law and the pair keeps a ledger <H_w> + F[u]): d<H_w>/du_x = e_x = Re chi_x^dagger (H_w chi)_x, the amplitude's energy density; the ledger is kept when the law's source is e with its mean removed (proved in that direction), and with another source s it moves at the rate sum (e - s) du/dt; pulls are matched iff sources are proportional to energies; with no master clock the field's energy has weight one, F = sum over bonds sqrt(w_x w_y) f(u_x - u_y), the unit of rate is not a variable, the coupling gamma is a pure number, and through second order the empty-space law is the averaging law for phi = sqrt(w); for the simplest bond energy F = (2/gamma) sum (phi_x - phi_y)^2 the law is (12/gamma) phi_x (phi_x - average of phi) = -(e_x - mu). NOT SETTLED there: whether an amplitude that has formed no record sources anything; how the field follows a change of its sources (the law is static). The parked statistical postulate (docs/repo/DEFERRED_DECISIONS.md, entry 1) is NOT to be assumed, adopted or re-raised; conditional statements that name their condition are fine. TASK: (a) RECORDS ONLY: a record of energy E enters block 53's law with log kappa = -(gamma/6) E/wbar and is pulled as block 54's packets are. A packet that sources nothing is pulled by records and pulls nothing back: say where the momentum goes (the records are permanent and do not move in the axioms; in the owner's reading of 2026-09-20 they move) and whether any ledger is kept. (b) FORMATION: an amplitude of energy E spread over a region of radius R forms a record at one site. Compute, for the simplest bond energy, the ledger before (amplitude sourcing, mean field) and after (a point record sourcing): the field's self-energy changes by an amount of order gamma E^2 (G_0(0) - 1/R-type term); give it exactly on the lattice in terms of the potential of the operator (1 - average) (G_0(0) = 1.5164 on Z^3). State what a formation rule would have to do to the record's energy for the ledger to be kept through the event, exactly or on average WITHOUT assuming any rule for where the record forms. (c) AMPLITUDE SOURCES: in the mean-field coupling an amplitude in two distant places sources half its energy at each; a test packet passing between them is pulled both ways. State one executed discriminator between (a) and (c) that uses only positions of formed records of the TEST body, and say plainly which assumptions about formation it needs. (d) Say which of the two readings is compatible with each sentence of the Record and Qualification axioms (read the memo in full first). check.py: exact rational evaluation of (b) on a box with walls held at the ambient rate.  DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/sources-under-the-record-reading/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/sources-under-the-record-reading/<name>/check.py"
